title: 第0011章 绝脉毒发系统觉醒第0012章 深山炼药拳破金石
content_zh:
夜色如墨，浓稠得化不开。
青炎城，林家后山，乱葬岗。
寒风呜咽，卷起地上枯败的落叶与森森白骨，发出鬼泣般的声响。空气中弥漫着一股令人作呕的腐臭气息，那是死亡与绝望的味道。
一道瘦削的身影，被毫不留情地扔在乱葬岗的中心。
“咳……咳咳……”
林药尘蜷缩在地上，浑身剧烈颤抖。他不过十六岁，却瘦弱得像是一阵风就能吹倒的枯草。原本粗布衣衫早已被撕扯得破烂不堪，裸露出的皮肤呈现出一种诡异的青黑色，尤其是双臂，血管如同黑色的蚯蚓般虬结凸起，仿佛随时都会爆裂开来。
“林啸天……你好狠的心……”
他牙关打颤，每一次呼吸都带着灼烧般的剧痛。一股阴寒彻骨的毒素正在他经脉中游走，所过之处，如同千万根钢针穿刺。
腐骨散。
林家少主林啸天亲手赐下的“馈赠”。这不仅是毒，更是对他这个旁系废柴的羞辱与终结。
三天前，家族小比。他因天生绝脉无法修炼，被林啸天当众讥讽为“林家的耻辱”、“只会拖后腿的废物”。争执间，林啸天偷下毒手，将这霸道的腐骨散灌入他口中。
族老冷眼旁观，旁系子弟指指点点，无人出手相助。在这个以武为尊、灵气枯竭的八荒世界，一个毫无价值的废柴，死了也就死了，甚至能省下一口饭食。
“我不甘心……”
林药尘死死咬着嘴唇，鲜血顺着嘴角流下，滴落在冰冷的泥土里。他脑海中闪过无数画面：父亲早逝，母亲含辛茹苦将他养大却积劳成疾离世；他在家族中受尽白眼，像条狗一样苟活；他拼尽全力想要修炼，却因绝脉一次次摔倒在地……
凭什么？
凭什么那些世家子弟生来就能享受灵药、修炼武道？凭什么他林药尘就要因为天生绝脉，被人随意践踏、毒杀，连尸骨都要喂野狗？
“老天爷……既然让我来到这世上，为何又要如此戏弄于我……”
他眼中布满血丝，绝望如潮水般淹没头顶。身体的痛苦还在加剧，毒素已经侵入心脉，他甚至能感觉到自己的生命正在飞速流逝。
意识逐渐模糊。
就在他即将彻底失去知觉的那一刻——

【叮！检测到宿主生命体征急速衰竭，强烈求生意志触发灵魂绑定……】
【万古药尊系统正在激活……激活成功！】
一道清脆冰冷的电子音突兀地在林药尘脑海中炸响。
紧接着，一幅虚幻的画卷在他眼前展开。
那是一片浩瀚无垠的星空，星空中悬浮着八株散发着璀璨光芒的仙草虚影。它们有的如仙鹤展翅，有的如雪莲绽放，有的根茎粗壮如龙，有的叶片晶莹剔透……每一株都蕴含着难以言喻的古老气息，仿佛承载着天地初开的本源力量。
【恭喜宿主获得万古药尊传承！】
【本系统致力于培育八荒最强药尊，以药入道，以武镇世，打破天地桎梏！】
【新手大礼包已发放，请宿主查收！】
林药尘原本涣散的瞳孔猛地收缩。
他看到了！
在那星空画卷中央，一株通体碧绿、叶片呈锯齿状的小草微微摇曳，洒下点点翠绿色的光华。光华中浮现出一行文字：
【仙鹤草（凡级·入门）】
【功效：收敛止血，固表止汗，强心救逆。】
【状态：已绑定为本命奇药之一，自动汲取天地游离药力温养宿主。】
几乎在文字出现的瞬间，一股温和而磅礴的药力从虚空中涌来，顺着林药尘的天灵盖灌入体内，直奔那已经寸断、且被腐骨散毒素侵蚀的经脉而去。
“呃啊——！”
剧烈的疼痛之后，是一种难以言喻的清凉舒爽。
那原本在他经脉中横冲直撞、如同毒蛇般的腐骨散毒素，竟然在这股清凉药力的冲刷下，变得温顺起来。虽然依旧存在，但却不再疯狂侵蚀他的血肉，而是被强行压制在某个角落。
不仅如此，他那干涸见底的丹田处，竟也传来一阵久违的暖意。虽然依旧无法储存灵气，但那种生命即将燃尽的感觉，正在迅速消退。
content_en:
The night was like ink, too thick to dissolve.
Qingyan City, the mountain behind the Lin family, and the mass graves.
The cold wind whimpered, rolling up the withered leaves and white bones on the ground, making a sound like a ghost's cry. There was a disgusting rancid smell in the air, the smell of death and despair.
A thin figure was mercilessly thrown into the center of the mass grave.
"Cough... cough cough..."
Lin Yaochen huddled on the ground, shaking violently. He was only sixteen years old, but he was as thin as a withered grass that could be blown down by a gust of wind. The original coarse clothes had been torn into tatters, and the exposed skin showed a strange green-black color, especially on the arms, where the blood vessels were like black earthworms, as if they were about to burst at any time.
"Lin Xiaotian...you are so cruel..."
His teeth chattered, and every breath brought burning pain. A cold and bone-chilling toxin was swimming in his meridians, and wherever it passed, it was like being pierced by thousands of steel needles.
Rotten bones scattered.
A "gift" personally given by Lin Xiaotian, the young master of the Lin family. This is not only poison, it is also a humiliation and end for him, a useless person from the sidelines.
Three days ago, there was a family competition. He was unable to practice because he was born with an inexhaustible pulse, and was ridiculed by Lin Xiaotian in public as "the shame of the Lin family" and "a waste that only hinders others". During the dispute, Lin Xiaotian secretly poured the overbearing rotten bone powder into his mouth.
The clan elders looked on with cold eyes, while the subordinates pointed and pointed, but no one came to help. In this world where martial arts is respected and spiritual energy is exhausted, a worthless waste will die and even save a mouthful of food.
"I'm not willing to..."
Lin Yaochen bit his lip, blood flowing down the corner of his mouth and dripping into the cold soil. Countless images flashed through his mind: his father died young, and his mother worked so hard to raise him but died of illness due to overwork; he was looked down upon by his family and lived like a dog; he tried his best to practice, but fell to the ground again and again because of his broken pulse...
Why?
Why are the children of those aristocratic families able to enjoy magical medicine and practice martial arts from birth? Why should Lin Yaochen be trampled on, poisoned and even his bones fed to wild dogs because he was born with no blood vessels?
"God...since you let me come into this world, why do you tease me like this..."
His eyes were bloodshot, and despair flooded his head like a tide. The pain in his body was still increasing, the toxins had invaded his heart, and he could even feel that his life was passing quickly.
Consciousness gradually blurred.
At the moment when he was about to lose consciousness completely——
[Ding! It is detected that the host's vital signs are rapidly declining, and the strong will to survive triggers soul binding...]
[The Eternal Yaozun system is being activated...Activation successful! 】
A crisp, cold electronic sound suddenly exploded in Lin Yaochen's mind.
Then, an illusory picture unfolded before his eyes.
It was a vast starry sky, with eight phantom grasses emitting bright light suspended in the starry sky. Some of them spread their wings like cranes, some bloom like snow lotuses, some have roots as thick as dragons, some have crystal clear leaves... Each one contains an indescribable ancient atmosphere, as if it carries the original power of the first opening of the world.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the inheritance of the Eternal Medicine Master! 】
[This system is dedicated to cultivating the strongest medicine master in the eight wastelands, using medicine to enter the Tao, using martial arts to control the world, and break the shackles of heaven and earth! 】
[The novice gift package has been distributed, please check the host! 】
Lin Yaochen's originally dilated pupils suddenly shrank.
He saw it!
In the center of the starry sky painting, a green grass with jagged leaves swayed slightly, shedding little emerald green brilliance. A line of text emerged from the light:
[Agrimony (ordinary level·entry level)]
[Efficacy: astringent and hemostasis, firming the surface and stopping sweating, strengthening the heart and relieving stress. 】
[Status: Bound as one of the miraculous medicines of life, automatically absorbing the free power of heaven and earth to warm and nourish the host. 】
Almost as soon as the words appeared,A gentle yet majestic medicinal power surged from the void, poured into Lin Yaochen's Tianling Gai, and went straight to the meridians that had been severed and corroded by rotten bone toxins.
"Uh-huh!"
After the severe pain, there is an indescribable coolness and relief.
The rotten bone powder poison that originally ran rampant in his meridians like a poisonous snake became docile under the wash of this cooling medicine. Although it still existed, it no longer crazily eroded his flesh and blood, but was forcibly suppressed in a corner.
Not only that, but his dry Dantian also felt a long-lost warmth. Although he still cannot store spiritual energy, the feeling that his life is about to burn out is fading quickly.
